title: Digital Home — Portfolio + Content System
summary: A static-hostable portfolio and content system with validation, generated indexes, and a local Studio for fast authoring — no backend.
problem: I didn’t want a one-off landing page. I wanted a portfolio that could grow like a small platform (projects + writing + life) while staying fast, maintainable, and easy to update.
approach: Designed a simple content model for projects, posts, experience, and education; added a build step to validate content and generate indexes; and built a shared rendering layer for consistent layout across pages. Kept everything dependency-light and static-hostable.
outcome: A clean multi-page site where content lives in `src/content`, build outputs live in `dist/`, and updates are as simple as editing local files and rebuilding.
